invariants: GitHub Pages environment retains jdhart81 approval and no admin bypass
No Supabase, authentication, worker, source, licence, account subscription or nameserver changes

github_pages_updates.when: After ownership verification, before traffic DNS changes
After DNS health checks and valid certificate for apex and www

ownership_verification.name: _github-pages-challenge-global-soil-intelligence
ownership_verification.instruction: Read any existing challenge after sign-in. If none exists, obtaining one requires a separately approved Add domain action. Show exact value before adding TXT. Keep verified TXT permanently.

not_authorized: Inventing or approving an unknown TXT value
Replacing the whole zone or DNS preset
Registrar transfer, changing NS/DNSSEC, cancelling Squarespace
Additional Pages deployment, any merge, opening capture or library intake

rollback.approval: Execute only within an explicit rollback authorization; stop and report failures otherwise
rollback.cache_caveat: Sampled resolvers cannot prove worldwide cache expiration; retain verified TXT.

account_preflight: Signed-in DNS inventory and nameservers match baseline; Domain Connect record preserved.
provider_ui_operation: If later approved, remove only Squarespace Defaults group containing exactly the two specified web records. Preserve Squarespace Domain Connect group and every custom record; add proposed records individually. Stop if group contents change.
